The ΛPEX wordmark face

Two candidate faces for the ΛPEX wordmark, shown on the logging screen just designed. Orbitron ExtraBold is what the design charter prescribes; Exo2 ExtraBold is what the shipping app uses today. In the app the Λ is a fixed chevron logo mark and only the letters PEX are set in type, so every specimen below pairs that same mark with PEX in each candidate face. Orbitron is on the left, Exo2 on the right.

Orbitron ExtraBold is geometric and wide: uniform stroke weight, open circular counters, and even proportions that keep the letters distinct as size drops. Exo2 ExtraBold is narrower and more technical, with lightly modulated strokes, angular terminals, and tighter default spacing, so it sets more compactly beside the Λ mark. Both lock cleanly to the chevron; the question is whether the wordmark should read wide and machined or condensed and technical. Pick one. It becomes the token.
